set: A: one sheet across each of the seven beats, with no time and no word on it

issues.what: the biggest event of the unit - the Submit button cracking the page and rising as a spider-machine - gets no reaction from the arrow; it holds the same pointer pose and in several frames is barely present, no recoil, no shocked hold
issues.fix: the instant the machine rises, streak the arrow backward, hold a tilted-back shocked pose with a small wobble for a beat, then let it set itself for the fight

issues.where: error-tag frames, and same pattern in set-A-04.png
issues.what: the hits never visibly land: 'Field cannot be blank' and 'Invalid input' tags fly past the arrow with no contact frame, no squash on impact, no knock-back arc; it tilts near the hole as if drifting, so the beating reads as weather, not as things hitting it
issues.fix: give each hit a contact frame with the tag against the arrow, the arrow squashed flat against its flight direction plus a small flash, then a tumble away

issues.what: the struggle beat is flat: near-identical frames of the arrow beaming the machine in the same pose, the attack never builds, and the machine blinks out entirely for one frame (r2c3) so a shot reads as hitting nothing
issues.fix: escalate the approach frame by frame - strain tilt, closer range, bigger flash on the hit - and keep the machine on screen in every frame

issues.what: the arrow is pure pointer here: it slides to the checkbox and the box is simply checked, no wind-up before the click and no held reaction after 'Humanity Confirmed'; nothing in the pose says nervous or relieved
issues.fix: hover-hesitate over the box, pull back in a small wind-up, dip-squash on the click, then a brief upright settled hold as the confirmation appears

issues.what: the arrow is roughly 5% of frame width at delivery size, so tilts and knock-backs that do exist (set-A-03, set-A-04) only read when zoomed
issues.fix: stage tighter or scale the arrow up, and exaggerate the tilt angles so a glance reads them

issues.where: dim frames here and in set-A-01 top rows
issues.what: at small scale the white arrow with dark outline collapses to a dark speck against the grey page, weakening the silhouette read
issues.fix: keep the fill bright with a clean dark outline and a contact shadow at every scale

issues.what: did not read: that the boss hurls error messages at the arrow is read; that the arrow dodges them and shoots a stream of small darts back with each click, and that the bar starts to drop, is not: the read has it shocked and knocked about beside the hole.
issues.fix: The dodge as a readable move clear of each slab, and the arrow's own fire seen leaving its tip and landing on the boss, with the bar answering each landing.

issues.what: did not read: the dialogs are read as more bombardment; that the boss raises them as shields, that the arrow shoots them down or goes round them, and that it takes a hit and shakes it off is not in the read.
issues.fix: The dialogs standing between the arrow and the boss as cover, the arrow's shots breaking one, its path round another, and one clear hit on the arrow followed by a shake held long enough to be read.

issues.what: did not read: the 'Session expired' banner and the arrow firing on are read; that the boss's health jumps back up and that the arrow's whole body says 'really' is not: the read has the bar draining while it is stubborn and worn down.
issues.fix: The bar seen to fill back up as the event of the beat, with the arrow stopped by it: a held pose of disbelief turned to the bar before it goes back to work.

reads.read: wary and dutiful; it arrives at the final step, studies the 'I am not a robot' box, clicks it and is confirmed human; it is about to try to submit
determined, then ambushed; it presses Submit and the button bucks, cracks the page open into a black slot and rises as a spider-machine
shocked and under fire; the machine hurls 'Field cannot be blank', 'Invalid input' and 'Session expired' errors at it and it is knocked about beside the hole
harried; the bombardment continues with a cookie 'Accept All' banner, a session-expiring warning and a 'leave this page?' dialog while it struggles to stay in the fight
stubborn and worn down; a 'Session expired' banner hangs over it as it keeps firing back at the machine while the progress bar drains
vindicated; the machine breaks apart into scattered debris as it watches, the fight is won
weary triumph; among the wreckage the battered Submit pill waits with 'Click to submit' and it flies in to finally finish
